# NeoBuzz Live: identifier rename map of CU5 (docs/specs/clips.md section 9): old name, then new name.
# Applied to the identifier tokens of C# code only, never to strings or comments (tools/clip-rename.py), so a name a saved file,
# a machine's reflection lookup or the agent's wire protocol stores never changes by it. Generated by the rule
# Pattern -> Clip, Patterns -> Clips (any case), except the words ModernPatternEditor and PatternXP, which are names of machines and data
# that songs store; with the overrides at the end. Names that the rule leaves are listed in tools/clip-rename-allowlist.txt.
